parameters.controller: Holds and edits the text; one is created if none is given.
parameters.placeholder: The words shown while the field is empty.
parameters.onChanged: Called with the text after each edit.
parameters.onSubmitted: Called with the text when the user submits it.
parameters.clearButtonMode: When a clear button shows at the end.
parameters.prefix: A widget before the text, such as a label.
